needs_user_input.why: No filing discloses an agency rating or outlook for iHeartMedia or iHeartCommunications; ratings must come from the user.
Market cap, net debt or EV and date are market data not in the filings; CP-4C needs an EV multiple basis for claim coverage.
EV multiple is a judgment choice; left unpinned so the model chooses and labels it an analyst assumption.
Stress scenarios are optional pinned assumptions; none supplied.

limitations: Figures printed in USD thousands carry scale 'thousands' and are not rescaled. The debt market value is printed as '$3.9 billion' (no billions scale exists), so it is stored as text.
The 8-K and press release give exchange amounts as 'approximately'; derived figures inherit that approximation.
Existing Term Loan residual principal is not stated and not derived (mixed thousands and millions operands); other residuals come from definitions in the new credit agreement (USD units).
Pre-exchange principal is as of 2024-09-30; no filing in the corpus gives balances on 2024-12-20 for non-exchanged items.
Ranking descriptions for pre-exchange instruments come from the FY2023 10-K note (filed 2024-02-29); the Q3 2024 10-Q does not repeat them.
Incremental Term Loan Facility due 2026 maturity: only the year is printed in the cited text; the 10-K gives May 1, 2026 for the Term Loan Facility itself.
The 8-K exhibit index describes the Second Lien Notes form as 'due 2029'; the 8-K body and press release state May 1, 2030 and 'due 2030'. Body figure used.
The 8-K states no cash consideration for the three notes pairs other than the 2026 notes and the Term Loans; none recorded.
The new credit agreement filed publicly omits exhibits and schedules; per-lender allocations are absent.
Post-exchange ABL commitment size is the 2024-09-30 facility size; no filing states a change other than the +0.50% rate increase.
